learnings: Decorator registration keeps plugins declarative: the function is registered and returned unchanged.
`importlib.util.spec_from_file_location` loads plugin files at runtime; entry points discover installed ones.
A plugin API version and all-or-nothing installation keep one broken plugin from breaking the bot.
pitfalls: Silent name clashes let one plugin hijack another's command – detect and reject duplicates.
next: Generate reports in several formats on Day 88.
